title: AI Integration Engineer

experienceProfile.rawText: <h5 style="text-align: center;"><strong>Integration meets Innovation</strong></h5> <p>At Celigo, we believe integration should empower - not exhaust - innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (i Paa S), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.</p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Integrations Engineer </strong>with expertise in Enterprise System Integrations and Business Process Automation. In this role, you will design, build, and deploy scalable integration solutions and automations, as well as develop AI chatbots using various technologies across multiple domains.</p> <p>The Global Technology Operations team is dedicated to digitally transforming and scaling Celigo's business, enhancing productivity, and improving operational efficiency. We work closely with top talent across the company to drive both our business operations and product development. As an Integrations Engineer, you will support the business and finance teams by seamlessly connecting systems and data. Additionally, you will build automations using integrator.io and AI concepts to eliminate redundant tasks, enabling teams to focus on higher-value activities.</p> <h5><strong>What would you do if hired?</strong></h5> <ul> <li>Champion the Celigo product through transformational integrations that enable scalable business growth.</li> <li>Design, build, and deliver scalable data pipelines leveraging modern cloud architectures.</li> <li>Collaborate with business process experts to develop solutions for complex systems and data platforms that drive revenue growth.</li> <li>Ensure your integrations adhere to engineering best practices, emphasizing data quality, accuracy, operability, and security.</li> <li>Contribute to the development of AI chatbots for internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Build and maintain trusted relationships with technical and business teams.</li> <li>Manage multiple projects concurrently, including operational tasks.</li> <li>Serve as the owner and final escalation point for your integrations.</li> <li>Produce clear, accurate technical documentation, develop support processes and procedures, and facilitate smooth hand-offs to peers and other organizational units.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>Who are we looking for?</strong></h5> <p><strong>Experience &amp; Technical Expertise:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Proven experience in developing AI agents or bots that autonomously interact with various tools and systems to derive and act upon business insights.</li> <li>Expertise in integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) such as Open AI's GPT series, Google's Gemini, or Anthropic's Claude with external APIs, vector databases, and enterprise platforms to automate workflows and enhance decision-making processes.</li> <li>Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and the orchestration of multi-step tasks using AI-driven solutions.</li> <li>At least 5 years designing and building integration solutions, ideally within Sales or Customer Success domains.</li> <li>Proficient with Enterprise i Paa S platforms (Celigo, Snaplogic, Boomi, Mulesoft, etc.).</li> <li>Strong expertise in developing integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, with at least 2 years of experience in JSON and XML schema design.</li> <li>Proficient in Java Script for data processing within integration projects.</li> <li>Familiar with various authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0, SAML2, and JWT Bearer Tokens.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with cloud applications like Salesforce, Hub Spot, Net Suite, Zendesk, Gong, Gainsight, and similar platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SQL, Snowflake stored procedures, AWS S3, and Redshift, along with a clear understanding of integration design patterns.</li> <li>Working knowledge on Agent SDKs, Model context protocol, Python is a plus.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Business Acumen &amp; Communication:</strong><strong><br><br></strong> <ul> <li>Able to quickly learn business processes, understand requirements, and communicate designs that address both technical and business challenges.</li> <li>Experience supporting business teams and a strong grasp of processes like Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Lead-to-Opportunity, and Hire-to-Retire.</li> <li>Excellent written communication skills; experience with data visualization (graphs and plots) is a significant advantage.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Collaboration &amp; Project Management:</strong><strong><br><br></strong> <ul> <li>Proven ability to interface with diverse stakeholders across various business units and levels, gathering requirements and managing follow-ups.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of delivering projects end-to-end with strong accountability.</li> <li>Thinks like an owner-takes full charge of projects from inception to delivery while keeping Celigo’s best interests in mind.</li> <li>Willingness to work flexible hours to effectively collaborate with US stakeholders.<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Additional QUALIFICATIONS: </strong> <ul> <li>A BS/BA in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.</li> <li>Knowledge of system and software engineering architecture principles and best practices is a plus.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Celigo is proud to be</strong></p> <ul> <li>A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for i Paa S. The <strong>ONLY</strong> vendor to receive this award.</li> <li>Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for i Paa S for the second consecutive year</li> <li>Celigo is ranked #1 i Paa S on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Here you’ll experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible, hybrid work culture that values autonomy, collaboration, and trust</li> <li>A fast-paced, high-growth environment where innovation and ownership are encouraged at every level</li> <li>Continuous learning and upskilling opportunities through internal training, mentorship, and global collaboration</li> <li>Exceptional teammates who bring passion, purpose, and creativity to everything they do</li> <li>A supportive, inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse ideas and perspectives</li> <li>Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees and dependents</li> <li>Generous leave benefits, including paid time off, wellness days, and parental leave</li> <li>Recognition programs and career growth opportunities designed to help you thrive</li> <li>Modern office spaces that promote connection, collaboration, and fun.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility</strong></p> <p>As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. jobDescription: <div id="how_to_sell_this_job_control" class="editable-field-control"> <div class="collapsed-field"> <div class="collapsed-field-text"> <p style="text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p> <h5 style="text-align: center;"><strong>Integration meets Innovation</strong></h5> <p>At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (i Paa S), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.</p> <p>Join a team of highly talented individuals committed to offering the best quality products in the area of business cloud computing (Saa S). In this position you will design and bring to market turnkey business apps for users of cloud systems such as Net Suite, Salesforce.com, Google, Amazon, Magento, and more.</p> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <p>We are looking for someone that absolutely loves to write code.&nbsp; Experience with Node JS is an added advantage, but if there are any really talented developers out there looking to try something new, we would love to hear from you too!. Must be technically credible to lead teams of world-class software engineers.</p> <p><strong>All candidates applying should have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in a relevant field (from only product based companies)</li> <li>Strong experience with Microservice architecture</li> <li>Experience to lead technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within the team.</li> <li>Experience in partnering with the product management team.</li> <li>Experience in the integration domain (Good to have)</li> <li>Experience in developing products which handle large data sets</li> <li>Experience in working on Saa S Solutions is an added advantage.</li> <li>Solid foundation in computer science with strong competency in</li> <li>Data structures and algorithms</li> <li>Design principles</li> <li>Software design (HLD,LLD)</li> <li>Performance/scalability</li> <li>Hands on experience in the following tech stack: <ul> <li>Node JS (is a plus / expertise in any other programming language would work)</li> <li>Mongo DB</li> <li>Python</li> <li>Amazon AWS</li> <li>Apache Kafka&nbsp;</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills</strong></p> <p>All candidates applying must have the following characteristics:</p> <ul> <li>Expected to drive a small set of technically strong individuals in an agile environment.</li> <li>Exceptional problem solver – able to design sound (and simple whenever possible) solutions to complex problems, including the ability to work from scratch</li> <li>Fast learner – ability to step in and develop working knowledge of a technology in a less than average amount of time</li> <li>Self-starter – motivation, work ethic and ambition to distinguish one’s self are key</li> <li>Genuine Interest in Technology – desire to be on the cutting edge of cloud-based technologies.</li> <li>Enjoy the start-up atmosphere and are flexible with shifting priorities.</li> <li>Think big and bring new ideas to the table—regardless of rank or title.</li> <li>Bring ambition, a proactive mindset and the ability to inspire others.</li> <li>Strive for results—always.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Celigo is proud to be</strong></p> <ul> <li>A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for i Paa S. The <strong>ONLY</strong> vendor to receive this award.</li> <li>Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for i Paa S for the second consecutive year</li> <li>Celigo is ranked #1 i Paa S on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Here you’ll experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible, hybrid work culture that values autonomy, collaboration, and trust</li> <li>A fast-paced, high-growth environment where innovation and ownership are encouraged at every level</li> <li>Continuous learning and upskilling opportunities through internal training, mentorship, and global collaboration</li> <li>Exceptional teammates who bring passion, purpose, and creativity to everything they do</li> <li>A supportive, inclusive workplace that celebrates diverse ideas and perspectives</li> <li>Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees and dependents</li> <li>Generous leave benefits, including paid time off, wellness days, and parental leave</li> <li>Recognition programs and career growth opportunities designed to help you thrive</li> <li>Modern office spaces that promote connection, collaboration, and fun.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility</strong></p> <p>As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about<a href="https://www.celigo.com/about-us/dei/"> Taking a Stand</a>.</p> <p>Celigo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </div> </div> </div>
